template.title: Fast iteration
template.summary: Tight policy for rapid experiments: low iteration cap, short wall-clock, single validation pass.

note: Fast-iteration template — tuned for quick smoke runs.

config.yaml:
# dev-loop configuration for this repository.
#
# Template: fast-iteration
# Optimised for getting a verdict in under a minute.

runs_dir: .dev-loop/runs
default_provider: replay
scenarios_dir: scenarios

policy:
  max_code_iterations: 2
  max_validation_attempts_per_iteration: 1
  max_diagnostic_rounds_per_failure: 1
  max_total_wall_clock_minutes: 10

notes: fast-iteration template — shrink the loop, fail fast.
